featured_reviews.name: Vinod Vyas
featured_reviews.review_text:
My experience with Mind Voyage has been truly transformative. Rasika Karkare is an exceptional therapist who combines empathy, deep understanding, and practical guidance in the most wonderful way. She has an incredible ability to listen patiently and make you feel completely heard and valued. What sets her apart is how she not only understands the root of the situation but also provides thoughtful, actionable suggestions and perspectives that really help in navigating life’s challenges.

In couple therapy especially, Rasika creates a safe, non-judgmental, and supportive space where both partners feel comfortable expressing themselves. Her insights are balanced and constructive, helping couples see situations more clearly and work towards healthier communication and stronger relationships.

I would highly recommend Rasika and Mind Voyage to anyone seeking clarity, healing, or growth — whether individually or as a couple. Her professionalism, compassion, and expertise make her a truly remarkable guide for life’s journey.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thanks a lot Vinod! Both of your participation & openness to the perspectives shown by me has made our work meaningful.

featured_reviews.name: Pushpita Mitra
featured_reviews.review_text:
I thought of giving therapy a try with Mind Voyage . And it turned out to be a decision I didn't knew I needed . In fact, I needed more of, with the help of Prasasha, my matched therapist on Mind Voyage, with her, I get to know myself from within to acknowledge my actions and know things about me that I have no idea for how long I have suppressed and kept confined in me, how much I over give and over invest which ultimately drains me.
It helped me to stand up for myself, assert boundaries strongly. I see , I bring first and foremost self- prioritisation more over anything or any given circumstances like never before.
This decision of seeking therapy was a random one, to now, it turned out, to be me recommending therapy to everyone and so, I recommend Mind Voyage to everyone.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you for your generous feedback Pushpita! We hope people reach out to therapy in need & it turns out to the best decision for themselves. Much like your journey! All the best ..

featured_reviews.name: Muskan Bohra
featured_reviews.review_text:
My partner and I have been taking couple therapy sessions with Rasika at Mind Voyage, and it has been such a valuable and much-needed experience for us.
We realized that we needed a safe and neutral space to talk openly, and Rasika provided exactly that. Each one-hour session feels calm, peaceful, and gives us the clarity we were missing in our conversations. What we appreciate most is her balanced approach — she listens to both of us without judgment and helps us see situations from each other’s perspective.
Over time, we’ve noticed a positive change in how we communicate, handle conflicts, and support each other. Therapy with Rasika has brought more understanding, patience, and peace into our relationship, and we are truly grateful for her compassionate guidance.
We highly recommend Mind Voyage for couples who want to strengthen their bond and grow together.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you very much Muskan! Such thoughtful & kind words, they motivate me a lot to keep up with the work.

featured_reviews.name: deepshikha purwar
featured_reviews.review_text:
We have been taking therapy with Rasika for over a year now, and it has been such a helpful journey for us. There were times when our conflicts felt like a dead end, but Rasika provided a safe and unbiased space where both of us could share openly without fear of being judged.

She listens with so much patience, understands both sides, and gives us perspectives we had never thought of before. Even when I come in with very complex questions or tangled emotions, she helps me unpack them gently and makes me more aware of what I am really feeling.

What I value most is that therapy with Rasika feels like a safe space – one where we can just be ourselves, feel what we feel, and know that someone is there to guide us without taking sides. Over time, we’ve not only understood each other better but also grown in our own emotional awareness.

We are truly grateful to Rasika for her support and guidance, and would highly recommend her to anyone looking for a kind, unbiased, and insightful therapist.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Hi Deepshikha! 
My heart feels full while reading this. Thank you for writing such kind words. I feel very glad you feel safe within the space we’ve created. You & your partner are definitely growing every session.

featured_reviews.name: Nidhi Parikh
featured_reviews.review_text: After some searching, I found MindVoyage and Ms. Khushi Sanghani during a particularly challenging time in my life. I vividly remember the relief I felt after our first session, and she has been instrumental in my journey of self-discovery ever since. Her friendly, positive, empathetic, and patient demeanor created a safe space for me to gradually open up about my feelings and emotions. Khushi has a remarkable ability to simplify complex thoughts and offered practical strategies to address negative thought and reaction patterns. Each session brought valuable self-awareness and new insights, which significantly boosted my confidence. Thanks to her guidance, I am now in a much better headspace and feel considerably stronger than I did a year ago.

featured_reviews.review_text: I took therapy sessions with Diya Kapur around this time last year, during one of the most difficult phases of my life. Those one-hour sessions were a comforting presence when I needed it the most. I am grateful for the safe and respectful environment she created. It became a meaningful starting point in my self-healing journey, and for that, I sincerely thank her and Mind Voyage.
